authorization.interpretation: Explicit acceptance of the configured-host candidate validation and upgrade-runbook compatibility review requested in operator-review.md.

restrictions: This decision accepts candidate evidence and compatibility review only. It authorizes no live-store opening, migration, restore, replacement or mutation.

Before rollout, inventory and rehearse the actual retained production binary/configuration, verify a SQLite-consistent backup, stop all readers/writers and MCP servers, and obtain separate authorization for the exact store, binary, schema and maintenance window.
Invalidate every retained cursor and validator after restore until persisted restore-generation detection exists; accept or reconcile later writes lost by rollback.

Historical host reports, transcripts, inventory snapshots and the original pending operator assessment remain unchanged. This signoff is a later decision and claims no new configured-host rerun for the fixed recorder.
No synchronization, mutation MCP, codec release, newer MCP protocol support or measured model-token saving is approved.
